source_observations.text: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord Yahweh says about Edom. We have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.

source_observations.text: Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.
Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says Yahweh.

Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.

source_observations.text: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.

boundary_rationale: The day formula generalizes the preceding charge, then reciprocal deed language and an as-so drinking image complete one proportional reversal declaration.

source_observations.text: For the day of Yahweh is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.
For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.

working_title: Zion Deliverance, House Reversal, Possession, and Kingdom
deciding_marker_or_seam: The adversative Mount Zion turn opens deliverance, holiness, and possession; house-fire reversal, repeated possession forms, territorial register, ascent/judgment, and 'the kingdom will be Yahweh's' close the book.
boundary_rationale: Repeated Zion, house, possession, Esau, and kingdom language bind the five-verse coda, but the speech seal at 1:18 and register opening at 1:19 create a genuine unresolved retrieval choice.
rejected_alternative: Surfacing 1:17-18 and 1:19-21 could honor the fire-oracle close and possession-register opening, while the literary 1:17-18, 1:19-20, 1:21 route recognizes the final acclamation; both risk detaching dependent children from the complete coda.
counterevidence: The divine speech seal at 1:18 is a strong close, verse 19 begins a distinct register, and verse 21 changes from place enumeration to climactic acclamation.
defensible_basis: The Zion counterturn initiates possession, the house reversal supplies its conflict image, verses 19-20 realize possession geographically, and verse 21 returns to Zion for the kingdom climax.
